items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: did you have any other teachers besides Rene and Charlene?

ctx.x: Yeah, he worked a lot of blues. I wish he was a blues man, you know. Uh huh. Do you know his blues today, any of them? Oh, it's so many. It's another thing. He played so much with himself. Careless, love, and all those other numbers like that.
Oh yeah, he'll be, he'll be. Uh, did you have any other teachers besides Rene and Charlene?
Well, no, no. Outside of Paul Barnes, well that was the way we were late years after. Cause we had an opposite together. Paul taught me a lot, you know. I see.
